items.question: What types of projects can I finance?
items.answer: Driveways, patios, pool decks, walkways, stamped concrete, outdoor living areas, and any other residential or commercial concrete service Maxima offers.

items.question: Which financing partner should I choose?
items.answer: Hearth is the quickest route for most concrete work — a soft credit check and an answer in about a minute. Lyon Financial is built for larger outdoor living investments, with amounts up to $250,000 and terms up to 30 years. You can apply to both and take whichever offer fits your budget.

items.question: Will applying affect my credit score?
items.answer: No. Pre-qualification uses a soft credit pull. A hard inquiry only happens if you accept a loan offer.

items.question: What credit score do I need?
items.answer: Programs are available for a wide range of credit profiles. Our lending partners review each application individually.

items.question: How long does approval take?
items.answer: Most homeowners receive a decision within minutes of submitting their application.
